Meta.title: SABMER — Mitsubishi lift installation
Meta.description: Subcontractor installing Mitsubishi lifts in Israel: stage bet — fitting the equipment, stage gimel — commissioning and handover. Over five years on site. Hiring fitters for our crews.

Hero.sub: End-to-end subcontracting: we fit the equipment, commission it and hand the lift over in service.

About.title: About
About.text: SABMER has been installing Mitsubishi lifts as a subcontractor for over four years. We carry a job through two stages:

stages.s1: Stage bet — the mechanics: machines, ropes, counterweight, cab and doors
stages.s2: Stage gimel — we start the lift in maintenance mode and bring the shaft and the cab through to full service

Founders.title: Founders
Founders.text: Two people run the company, and both came up on site: contracts, installation method and quality on the job are theirs. Amir has seven years in the lift trade. Vladimir trained as a site foreman at a university in Khabarovsk and has over fifteen years in construction — first there, now here in Israel.

Jobs.title: Terms of work
Jobs.intro: Employment on the books, wages on the 10th of every month. The terms:

terms.t1: We train from scratch — no lift experience needed
terms.t5: Coffee on arrival — half an hour
terms.t7: Work vehicle and workwear — on the company

Jobs.whatsappText: Hello! I would like to apply as a fitter.

items.name: Artemiy Pankratov
items.text: I came in with no experience at all and started from scratch. At first you work mostly as a helper; as you pick things up you do more and more on your own. Whenever something is unclear you ask a senior fitter, and they always help — no aggression, no shouting. Everything is exactly as advertised. Wages were never once late; they are paid on time and in full.
